packageRules.description: Every version lives once in the pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog and stays exact.
Workspace packages are released from this repository, never updated by Renovate.
Patch updates collect into one pull request that Renovate opens and refreshes once a day. The package groups below keep their own pull request but follow the same daily window.
Effect packages release together and must share one version, so they move in one update.
Prisma Classic packages must share one version.
Prisma Next packages must share one version.
`@types/pg` describes the `pg` runtime, so both move in one update and never drift apart. The update runs whenever either side has one instead of waiting for the daily patch window.

`@vercel/detect-agent` publishes from a private repository since 1.2.4, so its releases carry no provenance attestation and `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` refuses them (https://github.com/vercel/vercel/issues/17408). The workspace pins 1.2.3 for `@prisma-next/cli-telemetry`; drop this rule with that pin.
Better Auth stays on 1.7. Platform pins it as an exact peer, so moving to 1.8 is a planned migration, not a routine update.
